name: app-audit-monorepo
description: App Audit — plataforma de auditoria de segurança GitHub
author: Francisco Stanley Rodrigues Albuquerque

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w BackEnd" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w BackEnd && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w BackEnd && npm run test -w frontend
